cves.description: Path traversal and file disclosure in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 due to a flaw in path normalization. Can expose files outside the document root; with mod_cgi enabled it can lead to remote code execution.
cves.recommendation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later. Ensure 'Require all denied' is set for filesystem locations outside the document root.

cves.description: Remote code execution / path traversal in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 and 2.4.50. The fix for CVE-2021-41773 was incomplete; crafted requests can map URLs to files outside the document root and, with CGI enabled, execute code.
cves.recommendation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later immediately. This is a remotely exploitable RCE.

cves.description: Off-by-one heap write in the nginx resolver when processing crafted DNS responses, potentially leading to worker process crash or code execution.
cves.recommendation: Upgrade nginx to 1.20.1 or later, or disable the 'resolver' directive if not required.

cves.description: OpenSSH allows username enumeration via a timing/response difference for authentication requests, aiding targeted brute-force attacks.
cves.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 7.7 or later. Restrict SSH exposure with a firewall and key-based authentication.

cves.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 shipped with a backdoor that opens a root shell on TCP/6200 when a username containing ':)' is supplied.
cves.recommendation: Remove the compromised vsftpd 2.3.4 build immediately and install a clean package from a trusted repository.
